evidence.reason: Replaced the recursive mkdir in makeAppendLock with mkdirDurable, which records the deepest pre-existing ancestor before creating the chain and then fsyncs the parent of every directory it actually created (leaf first), so newly created ledger directory entries such as /state/new are persisted before consume reports consumed.
